units.source_text: 今年五月，千重子连葵节也没去参观。

en.t: This May, Chieko did not even go to see the Aoi Festival.

units.source_text: 五月多雨，是个原因，但是小时候经常被领去参加各种节日，不稀罕了，也是原因之一吧。

en.t: The rainy weather in May was one reason, but another was probably that, having often been taken to all sorts of festivals when she was a child, she no longer found them special.
